title: schc_session: authenticated install + generation currentness + atomic invalidate
description:
Parent project-LICHEN-worker6-l1qw.3.7.6 (spec/03-adaptation.md 5.6, authenticated bounded Zephyr SCHC session authority). Decomposed per Yegge's rule; this is one independently landable slice. Zephyr C in lichen/subsys/lichen/schc/ + host tests in lichen/tests/. Run host CMake tests on this Linux host (Attic toolchain absent; use local gcc/clang + cmake, ASan+UBSan per tests/cmake/test_common.cmake).

SLICE 3 (authority lifecycle, depends on slices 1-2): install SCHC policy ONLY from authenticated DIO evidence (no caller-selected authority). Revalidate that every applicable generation token is current before EVERY context mutation or control response. Revocation/replacement/rotation atomically invalidates every active context, tombstone, cached response, and admission floor in the retired generation - EVEN when the same pubkey is reinstalled (generation isolation). An unauthenticated fragment is silently dropped and MUST NOT trigger a control response. Unit tests: authenticated DIO install, currentness revalidation gate, same-key revoke->reinstall yields a fresh isolated generation (old state unreachable), forged/unauthenticated control silently dropped with no state mutation, atomic all-or-nothing invalidation. LAND AFTER slices 1-2.
close_reason: Landed schc_authority module (lichen/subsys/lichen/schc/schc_authority.{c,h}): trust-record lifecycle with internal monotonic generation minting (no caller-selected authority; token 0 reserved INVALID; fail-closed -EOVERFLOW at UINT64_MAX), install (mint+rotate), revoke (idempotent), generation/key currentness gates (read-only, fail-closed). Replacement/revoke atomically retires contexts+tombstones+floors of the retired generation via slice-2 invalidate BEFORE publishing the new token; same-key reinstall mints a fresh isolated generation. Cap 256 trust records fails closed (-ENOBUFS, no eviction of current records). Tests: lichen/tests/schc_authority 11/11 pass under ASan+UBSan (authenticated install, currentness gate, atomic all-or-nothing invalidation with bystander isolation, revoke->reinstall same-key isolation, forged/stale gate mutates nothing (byte-snapshot), cap fail-closed, replacement at full capacity, mint exhaustion). schc_session + schc_session_table tests still pass. cppcheck clean. 3x review: correctness (delegated kimi-k3: PASS, 1 trivial doc nit fixed inline), security (delegated kimi-k3: PASS), edge-cases (delegated reviewer timed out twice; pass done by implementer per worker protocol: found+fixed 1 coverage gap - replacement-at-capacity test). clang-tidy include-resolution failure is pre-existing tooling drift (b7z9.47), not this change.
